jurisdictions.name: Cheyenne (Laramie County)
jurisdictions.office: City of Cheyenne Building Permitting and Licensing Division
notes: The city says its Building Division is fully online: all permit applications and inspection requests go through the OpenGov portal.
The city lists the 2024 IBC, 2024 IRC and 2024 IPC among its adopted ICC codes, with the 2018 IECC and 2023 NEC.
The city will adopt the 2026 NEC on January 1, 2027, and accepts plans under either the 2023 or 2026 NEC until then.

jurisdictions.name: Laramie (Albany County)
jurisdictions.office: City of Laramie Building Department (Code Administration)
notes: The city requires building permits for most residential projects and publishes a short list of exceptions; it tells applicants to contact Code Administration if unsure.
Building, electrical, mechanical, plumbing and sign permits must all be applied for through the Civic Access web portal.
The city publishes informational bulletins on adopted codes and design criteria, plan and drawing standards, and site plan requirements.

sources.title: Building Permits and Informational Bulletins (City of Laramie)

jurisdictions.name: Jackson (Teton County)
jurisdictions.office: Town of Jackson Planning & Building Department
notes: The town's one and two family building permit application is submitted by email to townbuilding@jacksonwy.gov.
That application says separate permits are required for plumbing, mechanical and electrical work.
Grading information is submitted with the building permit; plan-level grading information must be prepared by a Wyoming-registered professional engineer or landscape architect unless exempted.

sources.title: One and Two Family Building Permit Application (Town of Jackson, effective June 2026)
